# Omnevum

> Omnevum is a private, local-first progressive web app for capturing, reviewing, and understanding life in context.

## Product

- [Live application](./): the deployable PWA shell.
- [Recovery route](./recovery.html): an independent local snapshot recovery path.

## Source

- [Repository](https://github.com/shfqrkhn/omnevum): source, documentation, tests, and release evidence.

## Boundaries

The application keeps canonical records local by default. AI, synchronization, connectors, and executable extensions are optional and must remain bounded and truthful when unavailable.
